A second click on the same answer clears it, so that a misclick is not final.

Whoever designs AND operates answers both: the score taken is that of the weaker one.

texte.Un alinéa est couvert quand TOUS les par: A subparagraph is covered when ALL the paragraphs Annex ZA associates with it are met, or it is not. « # % of article # » would make no sense — and Annex ZA is informative: it is Annex ZA that says what the standard covers, not this module.

texte.Un délai unique pour tout un système est: A single deadline for a whole system is almost always wrong
A single deadline for a whole system is almost always wrong: it is determined scenario by scenario, and the same system may call for milliseconds on one output and days on another.

texte.Une norme harmonisée citée au Journal of: A harmonised standard cited in the Official Journal and a common specification adopted by implementing act open a presumption of conformity: what remains is to document it. « Another standard » and « another technical solution » open none, and §# then calls for three more pieces — what is not covered, in writing, the justification of the choice, and objective evidence that the requirement is satisfied. The three boxes are there for that.
